feeds_accelerator_ids.note: Start = the main ring reaching its initial 30 GeV target energy in December 2008 (J-PARC history: "Initial target energy (30 GeV) was achieved at MR."); the first RCS injection into the ring happened earlier, during commissioning, and is not dated on the pages consulted. About 5 % of the RCS bunches go to the main ring; over 90 % go to the Materials and Life Science facility (J-PARC accelerators page).
feeds_accelerator_ids.quote: beam is accelerated up to 3 GeV by the RCS with a 25 Hz cycle. The harmonic number of the RCS is two, and there are two bunches in a cycle. About 5% of these bunches are supplied to the MR.

intervals.label: design energy reached
intervals.quote: October  Expected energy was achieved at RCS.

intervals.label: 181 MeV injection (before the Linac energy upgrade)
intervals.note: Start = the RCS reaching its expected 3 GeV energy (October 2007, J-PARC history); end = the Linac energy upgrade (January 2014).
intervals.quote: An H− beam is accelerated up to 400 MeV5 (181 MeV at present) by the LINAC, and is converted to an H+ beam by charge-stripping foils at the RCS injection.

injection_energy.quote: An H− beam is accelerated up to 400 MeV5 (181 MeV at present) by the LINAC, and is converted to an H+ beam by charge-stripping foils at the RCS injection.

beam_power.note: The J-PARC history page (2018 July) states: "Continuous operation with a beam power equivalent to 1 MW was succeeded at MLF" (the MLF is fed by the RCS). Cross-check: the facilities page states the MLF is driven by "3 GeV protons with a current of 333 micro-amps and a repetition rate of 25 Hz", and 3 GeV x 333 uA = 0.999 MW, i.e. 1 MW.
beam_power.quote: Continuous operation with a beam power equivalent to 1 MW was succeeded at MLF

injection_energy.note: Linac output energy since the January 2014 upgrade; 181 MeV before (see the interval below). The T2K paper (2011) quotes "400 MeV (181 MeV at present)".
injection_energy.quote: An H− beam is accelerated up to 400 MeV5 (181 MeV at present) by the LINAC, and is converted to an H+ beam by charge-stripping foils at the RCS injection.

summary.plain: A fast-cycling ring that takes protons from the linac up to 3 billion electronvolts 25 times a second, feeding both a neutron source and the main ring.
summary.technical: 3 GeV rapid-cycling synchrotron, about 350 m circumference, 25 Hz repetition, ~1 MW beam power to the Materials and Life Science Experimental Facility; injects into the main ring.
